captures.caption: Park the ship in the enemies' lane and hold fire: kills bank up, the tenth flips the W readout to 2 with a chirp over the explosion, and from there every enemy falls twice as fast.
captures.alt: Mid-game: the white ship near the bottom holding its column, green enemies falling, the score and lives readouts at the corners and a white W wave readout at the top centre.

captures.caption: The title screen, no longer silent: Twinkle Twinkle, Little Star on SID voice 1, looping under the scrolling starfield until fire is pressed.
captures.alt: The STARFIELD title screen with PRESS FIRE below it and stars drifting past.

captures.caption: The LFSR spawn: the three enemies scatter across the whole field, past the old X=175 ceiling too. No single column to park under, no right-side corner to hide in.
captures.alt: Three green enemies at widely different X positions across the screen, the white ship near the bottom.

captures.caption: The shipped game, half a minute of parking and holding fire: three lives still, untouched. Enemies keep to their narrow lane and never reach a ship that simply sits and shoots. The turret park.
captures.alt: The ship sitting near the bottom centre, three lives shown, green enemies drifting in a lane away from it.

captures.caption: The fixed game, the same half-minute of parking and holding fire: a life already gone, and the enemies bearing down on the ship's column from across the field. Sitting still is no longer safe — the game can be lost.
captures.alt: The ship near the bottom centre with green enemies converging on its column from above, the lives readout down to 2.
